CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`%` PROCEDURE `vettafi_backfill_full`(IN p_chunk BIGINT, IN p_run_id CHAR(36))
proc: BEGIN
  DECLARE v_min BIGINT; DECLARE v_max BIGINT;
  DECLARE v_from BIGINT; DECLARE v_to BIGINT;
  DECLARE v_aff BIGINT; DECLARE v_row BIGINT;

  SELECT MIN(id), MAX(id) INTO v_min, v_max
  FROM superpixel_resolution_log
  WHERE uuid IS NOT NULL AND uuid <> '' AND uuid <> 'null';

  IF v_min IS NULL THEN LEAVE proc; END IF;

  SET v_from = v_min;
  WHILE v_from IS NOT NULL AND v_from <= v_max DO
    SET v_to = LEAST(v_from + p_chunk - 1, v_max);

    INSERT INTO backfill_progress(run_id, phase, chunk_from, chunk_to, started_at)
    VALUES (p_run_id, 'insert', v_from, v_to, NOW());
    SET v_row = LAST_INSERT_ID();

    INSERT IGNORE INTO `superpixel_visitors` (
      uuid, first_name, last_name,
      personal_address, personal_city, personal_state, personal_zip, personal_zip4,
      age_range, children, gender, homeowner, married, net_worth, income_range,
      direct_number, direct_number_dnc, mobile_phone, mobile_phone_dnc, personal_phone, personal_phone_dnc,
      business_email, personal_emails, deep_verified_emails, sha256_personal_email, sha256_business_email,
      hem_sha256, job_title, headline, department, seniority_level, inferred_years_experience,
      company_address, company_description, company_domain, company_employee_count, company_linkedin_url,
      company_name, company_phone, company_revenue, company_sic, company_naics, company_city, company_state, company_zip, company_industry,
      linkedin_url, twitter_url, facebook_url, social_connections, skills, interests,
      skiptrace_match_score, skiptrace_name, skiptrace_address, skiptrace_city, skiptrace_state, skiptrace_zip,
      skiptrace_landline_numbers, skiptrace_wireless_numbers, skiptrace_credit_rating, skiptrace_dnc, skiptrace_exact_age, skiptrace_ethnic_code, skiptrace_language_code, skiptrace_ip,
      skiptrace_b2b_address, skiptrace_b2b_phone, skiptrace_b2b_source, skiptrace_b2b_website, valid_phones,
      url, element, percentage, referrer, event_timestamp, event_type,
      event_count, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, npn, crd, title
    )
    SELECT
      s.uuid, s.first_name, s.last_name,
      s.personal_address, s.personal_city, s.personal_state, s.personal_zip, s.personal_zip4,
      s.age_range, s.children, s.gender, s.homeowner, s.married, s.net_worth, s.income_range,
      s.direct_number, s.direct_number_dnc, s.mobile_phone, s.mobile_phone_dnc, s.personal_phone, s.personal_phone_dnc,
      s.business_email, s.personal_emails, s.deep_verified_emails, s.sha256_personal_email, s.sha256_business_email,
      s.hem_sha256, s.job_title, s.headline, s.department, s.seniority_level, s.inferred_years_experience,
      s.company_address, s.company_description, s.company_domain, s.company_employee_count, s.company_linkedin_url,
      s.company_name, s.company_phone, s.company_revenue, s.company_sic, s.company_naics, s.company_city, s.company_state, s.company_zip, s.company_industry,
      s.linkedin_url, s.twitter_url, s.facebook_url, s.social_connections, s.skills, s.interests,
      s.skiptrace_match_score, s.skiptrace_name, s.skiptrace_address, s.skiptrace_city, s.skiptrace_state, s.skiptrace_zip,
      s.skiptrace_landline_numbers, s.skiptrace_wireless_numbers, s.skiptrace_credit_rating, s.skiptrace_dnc, s.skiptrace_exact_age, s.skiptrace_ethnic_code, s.skiptrace_language_code, s.skiptrace_ip,
      s.skiptrace_b2b_address, s.skiptrace_b2b_phone, s.skiptrace_b2b_source, s.skiptrace_b2b_website, s.valid_phones,
      s.url, s.element,
      CASE WHEN s.percentage IS NOT NULL AND s.percentage <> '' THEN CAST(s.percentage AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END,
      s.referrer, s.event_timestamp, s.event_type,
      1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, s.npn, s.crd, s.title
    FROM `superpixel_resolution_log` s
    LEFT JOIN `superpixel_visitors` v ON v.uuid = s.uuid
    WHERE s.id BETWEEN v_from AND v_to
      AND s.uuid IS NOT NULL AND s.uuid <> '' AND s.uuid <> 'null'
      AND v.uuid IS NULL;

    SET v_aff = ROW_COUNT();
    UPDATE backfill_progress SET affected_rows = v_aff, finished_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = v_row;

    INSERT INTO backfill_progress(run_id, phase, chunk_from, chunk_to, started_at)
    VALUES (p_run_id, 'update', v_from, v_to, NOW());
    SET v_row = LAST_INSERT_ID();

    UPDATE `superpixel_visitors` v
    JOIN `superpixel_resolution_log` s ON s.uuid = v.uuid
    SET
      v.first_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.first_name,''), s.first_name),
      v.last_name  = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.last_name ,''), s.last_name),
      v.business_email = CASE WHEN v.business_email IS NOT NULL AND v.business_email <> '' THEN v.business_email ELSE s.business_email END,
      v.personal_emails = CASE WHEN v.personal_emails IS NOT NULL AND v.personal_emails <> '' THEN v.personal_emails ELSE s.personal_emails END,
      v.deep_verified_emails = CASE WHEN v.deep_verified_emails IS NOT NULL AND v.deep_verified_emails <> '' THEN v.deep_verified_emails ELSE s.deep_verified_emails END,
      v.sha256_personal_email = CASE WHEN v.sha256_personal_email IS NOT NULL AND v.sha256_personal_email <> '' THEN v.sha256_personal_email ELSE s.sha256_personal_email END,
      v.sha256_business_email = CASE WHEN v.sha256_business_email IS NOT NULL AND v.sha256_business_email <> '' THEN v.sha256_business_email ELSE s.sha256_business_email END,
      v.hem_sha256 = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.hem_sha256,''), s.hem_sha256),
      v.direct_number = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.direct_number,''), s.direct_number),
      v.direct_number_dnc = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.direct_number_dnc,''), s.direct_number_dnc),
      v.mobile_phone = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.mobile_phone,''), s.mobile_phone),
      v.mobile_phone_dnc = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.mobile_phone_dnc,''), s.mobile_phone_dnc),
      v.personal_phone = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.personal_phone,''), s.personal_phone),
      v.personal_phone_dnc = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.personal_phone_dnc,''), s.personal_phone_dnc),
      v.personal_address = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.personal_address,''), s.personal_address),
      v.personal_city = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.personal_city,''), s.personal_city),
      v.personal_state = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.personal_state,''), s.personal_state),
      v.personal_zip = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.personal_zip,''), s.personal_zip),
      v.personal_zip4 = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.personal_zip4,''), s.personal_zip4),
      v.age_range = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.age_range,''), s.age_range),
      v.children = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.children,''), s.children),
      v.gender = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.gender,''), s.gender),
      v.homeowner = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.homeowner,''), s.homeowner),
      v.married = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.married,''), s.married),
      v.net_worth = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.net_worth,''), s.net_worth),
      v.income_range = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.income_range,''), s.income_range),
      v.job_title = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.job_title,''), s.job_title),
      v.headline = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.headline,''), s.headline),
      v.department = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.department,''), s.department),
      v.seniority_level = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.seniority_level,''), s.seniority_level),
      v.inferred_years_experience = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.inferred_years_experience,''), s.inferred_years_experience),
      v.company_address = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.company_address,''), s.company_address),
      v.company_description = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.company_description,''), s.company_description),
      v.company_domain = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.company_domain,''), s.company_domain),
      v.company_employee_count = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.company_employee_count,''), s.company_employee_count),
      v.company_linkedin_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.company_linkedin_url,''), s.company_linkedin_url),
      v.company_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.company_name,''), s.company_name),
      v.company_phone = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.company_phone,''), s.company_phone),
      v.company_revenue = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.company_revenue,''), s.company_revenue),
      v.company_sic = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.company_sic,''), s.company_sic),
      v.company_naics = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.company_naics,''), s.company_naics),
      v.company_city = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.company_city,''), s.company_city),
      v.company_state = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.company_state,''), s.company_state),
      v.company_zip = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.company_zip,''), s.company_zip),
      v.company_industry = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.company_industry,''), s.company_industry),
      v.linkedin_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.linkedin_url,''), s.linkedin_url),
      v.twitter_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.twitter_url,''), s.twitter_url),
      v.facebook_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.facebook_url,''), s.facebook_url),
      v.social_connections = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.social_connections,''), s.social_connections),
      v.skills = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skills,''), s.skills),
      v.interests = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.interests,''), s.interests),
      v.skiptrace_match_score = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_match_score,''), s.skiptrace_match_score),
      v.skiptrace_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_name,''), s.skiptrace_name),
      v.skiptrace_address = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_address,''), s.skiptrace_address),
      v.skiptrace_city = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_city,''), s.skiptrace_city),
      v.skiptrace_state = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_state,''), s.skiptrace_state),
      v.skiptrace_zip = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_zip,''), s.skiptrace_zip),
      v.skiptrace_landline_numbers = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_landline_numbers,''), s.skiptrace_landline_numbers),
      v.skiptrace_wireless_numbers = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_wireless_numbers,''), s.skiptrace_wireless_numbers),
      v.skiptrace_credit_rating = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_credit_rating,''), s.skiptrace_credit_rating),
      v.skiptrace_dnc = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_dnc,''), s.skiptrace_dnc),
      v.skiptrace_exact_age = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_exact_age,''), s.skiptrace_exact_age),
      v.skiptrace_ethnic_code = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_ethnic_code,''), s.skiptrace_ethnic_code),
      v.skiptrace_language_code = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_language_code,''), s.skiptrace_language_code),
      v.skiptrace_ip = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_ip,''), s.skiptrace_ip),
      v.skiptrace_b2b_address = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_b2b_address,''), s.skiptrace_b2b_address),
      v.skiptrace_b2b_phone = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_b2b_phone,''), s.skiptrace_b2b_phone),
      v.skiptrace_b2b_source = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_b2b_source,''), s.skiptrace_b2b_source),
      v.skiptrace_b2b_website = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.skiptrace_b2b_website,''), s.skiptrace_b2b_website),
      v.url = s.url,
      v.element = s.element,
      v.percentage = COALESCE(CASE WHEN s.percentage IS NOT NULL AND s.percentage <> '' THEN CAST(s.percentage AS SIGNED) END, v.percentage),
      v.referrer = s.referrer,
      v.event_timestamp = s.event_timestamp,
      v.event_type = s.event_type,
      v.npn = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.npn,''), s.npn),
      v.crd = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.crd,''), s.crd),
      v.title = COALESCE(NULLIF(v.title,''), s.title),
      v.event_count = v.event_count + 1,
      v.last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE s.id BETWEEN v_from AND v_to;

    SET v_aff = ROW_COUNT();
    UPDATE backfill_progress SET affected_rows = v_aff, finished_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = v_row;

    SET v_from = v_to + 1;
    DO SLEEP(0.02);
  END WHILE;
END
